title: Can I BEAT Torpedo Chess?
summary: First Torpedo Chess video vs online humans (up to ~1840): pawns can always move one or two squares forward. Goal: win three games. Game 1 he grabs space with ...d6-d4 and wins a knight then mates; he wins three, plus a draw vs an experienced 1800 ('three and a half out of the intended three points').
rules: Pawns can move one or two squares forward from any rank (path must be empty).
En passant applies to torpedo double steps (chess.com torpedo rule; shown in his later Torpedo video).
current_impl_issues: Legacy 'torpedo' matches; goal is 3 wins here.
evidence: SRT 0:00 'torpedo chests where pawns can always move either one or two squares forward my goal is to win three games'; 5:50 'game ends with Checkmate'; 16:20 'three and a half out of the intended three points... rated 1,800 and some and we did hold off for a draw'.
